title: dispatch-gates / check-governed-merges count changed lines with --no-renames, so a rename-heavy PR reads far over the 3000-line threshold that GitHub's additions+deletions (the authority) puts it under
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ① defect with a named producer and a reproduction (a fleet instrument). Reported by the dev of #30291 (report comment 6671781042, out-of-scope finding class a) and verified by the epic PM on origin/main.

**Which fleet decision this changes** ("Instruments serve the fleet"): a dev told by `dispatch-gates` that a diff is over the 3000-line human-merge threshold stops and splits work that GitHub would not count as over the line. The seat then grades the PR by the wrong number.

## Producer

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `changedLinesFromGit` (≈ line 15268 on origin/main) runs `git diff --numstat --no-renames <merge-base>`.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`'s `--branch` and sweep modes read `--numstat --no-renames` the same way (header ≈ lines 198, 247, 257).
- With `--no-renames`, a moved file counts as a full delete plus a full add.

## Authority it disagrees with

pm-dispatch SKILL.md (ACCEPT 之后的路径分叉) defines the threshold reading as **PR additions + deletions**, and GitHub computes those rename-aware.

## Reproduction (measured)

| PR | `--no-renames` reading | rename-aware (`-M`) | GitHub additions+deletions |
|---|---|---|---|
| #30594 | 4324 (+3000/−1324) | 1806 | 1806 (+1741/−65) |
| #30375 | 6567 | 1561 | 1561 |
| #30550 | 3228 | 2482 | 2482 |

## Ask

The size reading these tools print for the human-merge threshold should match the authority (GitHub's rename-aware additions+deletions), or each tool should print both numbers and name which one binds.
- Keep `--no-renames` wherever it really serves its purpose. The name-list use at `dispatch-gates.mjs` ≈15246 needs both paths for gate derivation and is correct; only the size count is wrong.
- Any self-test that pins the size reading moves with it.

Dedup: open issues mentioning "no-renames": 9, none about the size reading. "changedLinesFromGit": only #30291 (this report's source). "rename detection" open: 2, unrelated.
